d:
AAP has released its first list of 40 candidates for the 2027 Punjab Assembly elections. Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann will contest again from Dhuri, while jailed minister Sanjeev Arora has been fielded from Ludhiana West. The party has retained 37 sitting MLAs, signalling confidence in its existing leadership ahead of the high-stakes Punjab polls.
